summary: The Materialized View Sync on 12 November 2026 (notes are AI-generated) was about readiness to vote on the materialized view spec. Two PMC approvals are in hand, from Steve and Russell, and the group agreed to stop pre-gaming and send the vote: Jan sends the email on Monday with a 72-hour window. The notes frame the MV spec as independent from the table spec and V4, a 'View V2' that uses existing snapshot properties; a REST spec for materialized views is a separate workstream. Implementation status was reported for Trino, Spark, Flink, Snowflake, AWS and BigQuery, with Spark availability at best in Iceberg 1.13.

topics.title: Vote readiness
topics.summary: The spec pull request has approvals from Steve and Russell, both PMC members. Dan has not yet approved but was heavily involved early, and Talat tagged him and Ryan Blue. The notes give the requirement as 2 to 3 PMC approvals with no PMC minus votes. The consensus was to stop pre-gaming the vote, send it and let the process run, treating any minus vote as constructive feedback to address.
decisions: Stop pre-gaming the vote: send it and let the process run. A minus vote is treated as constructive feedback and addressed.

topics.title: Vote timeline
topics.summary: Jan is to send the vote email on Monday, followed by a 72-hour voting window, with a result expected within about a week of sending. The notes give two different dates for that Monday: 12 November in the timeline section and 16 November in the next steps. PMC members including Dan and Ryan Blue are to be tagged.
decisions: Jan sends the vote email on Monday, with a 72-hour voting window.

topics.title: Spec versioning and scope
topics.summary: The materialized view spec is described as independent from the table spec and V4: the additions use existing snapshot properties and no new table-side metadata, so it is framed as 'View V2' rather than 'Table V4'. The notes list Iceberg's independent specs as table, view, REST, GMC encryption and UDF, and say the REST spec for materialized views still needs to be defined as a separate workstream. An open question was flagged on the dependency between MV spec and table spec versions; Jan started a thread on it and Dan's response suggests no impact.
open_questions: Is there a dependency between the MV spec and table spec versions? Dan's reply on Jan's thread suggests no impact; Nevin and Alex are to flag any remaining concerns.
The REST spec for materialized views still needs to be defined.

topics.title: Implementation status
topics.summary: Marius has implemented the spec on Trino and Valah (as the notes spell the name) for Spark, where a reference implementation exists. Talat is working on Flink with Vladislav, waiting for Iceberg core changes to merge first; the Flink issues he knows of are not spec-related. Igor said Snowflake has not started coding and will prioritise it once the spec lands. AWS has released an implementation largely based on the spec, and BigQuery has a pull request in review. The best-case timeline for Spark availability is Iceberg 1.13, roughly 3 to 4 months out.
